stops.note: described a wall-like, steep-sided bank formed by erosion
used of gullies eroded by storm water on the South African veld
spread into English usage via the Boer War and Australian soldiers who served there
stops.meaning: a dry, steep-sided ravine cut by water erosion

current_meaning: a steep-sided gully or ravine cut by water erosion, usually dry except in the rainy season
